summary: Christine Weston Chandler, an autistic webcomic artist from Virginia known online as Chris Chan, was relentlessly harassed by internet trolls from 2007 onward, a campaign that spawned Kiwi Farms and ended in her 2021 arrest and a transphobic media frenzy.

evidence.note: birth in February 1982 at a Charlottesville, Virginia hospital
Something Awful forum users discover her in October 2007, start of the harassment
childhood abuse by a babysitter and school restraint dispute
store security and police hogtie and jail her over loitering
Kiwi Farms founded specifically to follow and mock her
catfishing trolls coerce her into sexual acts; one is a 13-year-old
Idea Guys blackmail her into self-harm, false confessions and hitting her mother
2021 incest arrest; jail reclassifies her gender
Tucker Carlson and right-wing outlets frame the case as a trans culture-war story
hearings continued into 2022; still jailed at release
suicide of emulator developer Near after Kiwi Farms harassment

notes: Primary subject is the harassment target rather than a conventional bastard; the hosts stress she is not sympathetic but is mainly a victim. Roles describe what she did (online comics creator). No theme for online harassment or disability; tech-internet is closest. Scope set to online since most events happen on forums, though real-world Virginia events get real time. Birth year from the garbled transcript plus known 1982 date.
